editorial.blurb: Authentic Indian cooking with consistently stellar spiced dishes and genuinely warm service that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Gobi Manchurian as your appetizer, then go for the Chicken Vindaloo if you want real heat—the staff will warn you if you're pushing it. Garlic naan is so good you'll want extras, and it's BYOB so grab drinks from nearby before you sit.
